comment: Measured on the compiled WASM (wasm32v1-none, contract profile) by the wasm_budget tests, which fail when a figure moves above its baseline by more than tolerance_percent. A change that moves one re-measures it and updates this file and docs/reference/benchmarks.md together. network_contract_max_size_bytes is the contract_max_size_bytes setting read from testnet and mainnet on 2026-11-24.
